info.title: GophKeeper API
info.description:
GophKeeper keeps logins and passwords, texts, files, bank cards and OTP generators of its users.

The secrets are encrypted on the client with a key derived from the master password: the server stores opaque data and never sees the plaintext. Every change of an item gets a new version, which the clients use for incremental sync and for optimistic locking.

gRPC is the main protocol; this REST API mirrors it one to one. Errors come as google.rpc.Status: 400 invalid argument, 401 bad credentials or token, 404 no such item, 409 login taken, item exists or version conflict.

tags.name: AuthService
tags.description:
AuthService signs users up and in. Its methods are the only ones that
work without a token.

tags.name: ItemService
tags.description:
ItemService keeps the encrypted items of the signed-in user. Every call
needs the token in the "authorization" metadata (the Authorization header
in REST) as "Bearer <token>"; without a valid one it fails with
UNAUTHENTICATED.

post.description:
Returns a fresh token. Fails with UNAUTHENTICATED if the login is unknown
or the password does not match; the two cases are not told apart.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: LoginRequest holds the credentials of an existing account.

post.description:
Returns a token for the new account. Fails with ALREADY_EXISTS if the
login is taken and with INVALID_ARGUMENT if the login or the password is
empty or too long.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: RegisterRequest holds the credentials of a new account.

get.summary: ListItems streams the changes after a version
get.description:
Sends, one per message and ordered by version, every item whose version
is greater than since_version, tombstones included. A client keeps the
greatest version it has seen and passes it next time, so that it gets
only the changes made since its last sync. Zero lists everything.

parameters.name: sinceVersion
parameters.description:
SinceVersion is the greatest version the client already has; zero lists
everything.

post.description:
The client chooses the ID, so that an item created offline keeps it after
the sync; if the ID is empty, the server generates one. Fails with
ALREADY_EXISTS if the user already has an item with this ID, deleted ones
included.

get.description: Fails with NOT_FOUND if there is no such item or it has been deleted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the ID of the item.

delete.description:
The item turns into a tombstone without data, so that other clients learn
about the deletion on their next sync. Like UpdateItem, it needs the
current version and fails with ABORTED otherwise.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the ID of the item.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description:
Version is the version the client wants to delete: it must still be the
current one.

put.summary: UpdateItem replaces the data of an item
put.description:
The version in the request must be the current version of the item:
otherwise another client has changed it in the meantime, and the call
fails with ABORTED. Fails with NOT_FOUND if there is no such item or it
has been deleted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the ID of the item.

data.description: Data is the new encrypted secret, not empty.

version.description:
Version is the version the client has changed: it must still be the
current one.

ItemServiceUpdateItemBody.description: UpdateItemRequest is new data for an item.

id.description: ID is a UUID for the item. If empty, the server generates one.

type.description: Type is the kind of the secret.

data.description: Data is the encrypted secret, not empty.

id.description: ID is the ID of the item.

version.description: Version is the version of the item.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is when the item was stored.

v1CreateItemResponse.description: CreateItemResponse tells how the server stored the new item.

version.description: Version is the version of the tombstone.

v1DeleteItemResponse.description: DeleteItemResponse tells the version of the tombstone.

id.description: ID is a UUID; the client that created the item has chosen it.

type.description: Type is the kind of the secret.

data.description:
Data is the secret encrypted on the client, together with its name and
metadata. Empty for a deleted item.

version.description:
Version is a number that grows with every change of any item of the
user. It orders the changes for sync and guards updates.

deleted.description:
Deleted marks a tombstone: the item has been deleted, and the clients
should delete their copies.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is when the server stored the latest change.

v1Item.description: Item is a secret of a user as the server keeps it.

v1ItemType.description:
ItemType is the kind of secret an item holds. It is the only thing about
the content the server knows.

 - ITEM_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: The type is not set; the server rejects such items.
 - ITEM_TYPE_CREDENTIALS: A login and password pair.
 - ITEM_TYPE_TEXT: Arbitrary text.
 - ITEM_TYPE_BINARY: Arbitrary binary data, such as a file.
 - ITEM_TYPE_CARD: Bank card details.
 - ITEM_TYPE_OTP: A generator of time-based one-time passwords (TOTP).

item.description: Item is a changed item or a tombstone.

v1ListItemsResponse.description: ListItemsResponse is one changed item of the stream.

login.description: Login is the login the account was registered with.

password.description: Password is the password of the account.

v1LoginRequest.description: LoginRequest holds the credentials of an existing account.

login.description: Login is unique across the users, up to 256 bytes.

password.description:
Password is up to 72 bytes. The official client does not send the master
password itself but a key derived from it, so the server never learns
the password the data is encrypted with.

v1RegisterRequest.description: RegisterRequest holds the credentials of a new account.

v1RegisterResponse.description: RegisterResponse holds the token of the new account.

version.description: Version is the new version of the item.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is when the change was stored.

v1UpdateItemResponse.description: UpdateItemResponse tells the new version of the item.

Bearer.description: The token from register or login, as "Bearer <token>".
Bearer.name: Authorization
